summary: Off-registry HTTPS dependency source resolves install to attacker-controlled host
details: package.json at line 12 declares the sole dependency `daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` as the bare HTTPS URL `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns, unpinned and with no integrity check, and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest is the package's entire effective payload. The host `artifacts.creditslib.com` is unrelated to the `@flexmr` scope's publisher, and the content served there is mutable at the host operator's discretion. The `@flexmr/utils` name under a generic `utils` description with a stub re-export is also consistent with a dependency-confusion lure against an internal package of the same name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
